definitions.gloss: 88th birthday; celebration of one's eighty-eighth year
definitions.explanation: A traditional celebration of a person's 88th birthday. The name comes from the character {米|べい} (rice), which can be visually decomposed into strokes resembling {八十八|はちじゅうはち} (eighty-eight).

examples.japanese: {米寿|べいじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧、{米寿|べいじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather turned eighty-eight this year.

examples.japanese: {米寿|べいじゅ}のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧として⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{記念品|きねんひん}→記念品：03049_kinenhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{贈|おく}られた。
examples.english: All the relatives gave him a commemorative gift to celebrate his eighty-eighth birthday.

notes:
{米寿|べいじゅ} celebrates a person's 88th birthday, one of the traditional Japanese longevity milestones (⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧). The name comes from the character ⟦{米|べい}→米：28297_bei⟧ (rice), whose strokes can be read as {八十八|はちじゅうはち} (eighty-eight); the traditional celebratory color is gold.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {米寿|べいじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach one's eighty-eighth year
- {米寿|べいじゅ}のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: an 88th-birthday celebration

TYPES:
Part of a sequence of longevity milestones: ⟦{古希|こき}→古希：29070_koki⟧ (70), ⟦{喜寿|きじゅ}→喜寿：29071_kiju⟧ (77), ⟦{傘寿|さんじゅ}→傘寿：30987_sanju⟧ (80), {米寿|べいじゅ} (88), ⟦{卒寿|そつじゅ}→卒寿：30989_sotsuju⟧ (90), ⟦{白寿|はくじゅ}→白寿：30990_hakuju⟧ (99).
